items.title: Palo Alto Networks Patches PAN-OS Zero-Day Exploited for Remote Code Execution
items.summary: The company says it’s aware of limited exploitation against customers’ firewalls, and it has made IoCs available. The post Palo Alto Networks Patches PAN-OS Zero-Day Exploited for Remote Code Execution appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: Palo Alto Networks 修補用於遠端執行程式碼的 PAN-OS 零日漏洞
items.summary_zh: 該公司表示已獲悉針對客戶防火牆的有限利用行為，並已提供侵害威脅指標（IoC）。這篇文章 Palo Alto Networks Patches PAN-OS Zero-Day Exploited for Remote Code Execution 首先發表於 SecurityWeek。

items.title: Ledger asks sellers across Asia to halt sales after supply-chain attack
items.summary: Ledger has asked resellers and distributors of its wallets in Indonesia, Singapore, Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia, and Hong Kong to suspend device sales and remove products from shelves while it investigates device tampering. [...]

items.summary_zh: Ledger 已要求印尼、新加坡、泰國、菲律賓、越南、馬來西亞和香港的錢包零售商與分銷商，在調查裝置遭竄改期間暫停販售裝置並將產品下架。[...]

items.title: CenterPoint Energy Data Breach Impacts 1 Million Texans
items.summary: Personal information such as names, addresses, Social Security numbers, and driver’s license numbers was compromised. The post CenterPoint Energy Data Breach Impacts 1 Million Texans appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: CenterPoint Energy 資料外洩事件波及 100 萬名德州居民
items.summary_zh: 姓名、地址、社會安全號碼和駕駛執照號碼等個人資訊已遭外洩。CenterPoint Energy 資料外洩事件波及 100 萬名德州居民的文章首次出現在 SecurityWeek 上。

items.title: UK Legal Aid Agency: Hackers stole records dating back to 1978
items.summary: The Legal Aid Agency (LAA), an executive agency of the UK's Ministry of Justice that manages the country's Public Defender Service, says attackers who breached its IT systems in April 2025 stole records dating back to 1978. [...]
items.title_zh: 英國法律援助局：駭客竊取可追溯至 1978 年的記錄
items.summary_zh: 英國司法部旗下負責管理該國公設辯護人服務（Public Defender Service）的執行機構「法律援助局」（LAA）表示，於 2025 年 4 月入侵其 IT 系統的攻擊者竊取了可追溯至 1978 年的記錄。[...]

items.title: The Blind Spots of Agentic Pentesting and How to Close Them
items.summary: AI-powered penetration testing can uncover complex attack paths, but safety restrictions and network limitations leave many assets and vulnerabilities untested. Picus Security explains how combining agentic pentesting with exposure validation and breach simulation can help close these gaps. [...]
items.title_zh: 代理型滲透測試的盲點及其彌補方法
items.summary_zh: 人工智慧驅動的滲透測試可以揭露複雜的攻擊路徑，但安全限制和網路限制使許多資產和漏洞未經測試。Picus Security 解釋了如何結合代理型滲透測試（agentic pentesting）、暴露驗證與入侵模擬來協助填補這些漏洞。[...]

items.title: Cisco Warns of Exploited Secure Email Gateway Vulnerability
items.summary: Unauthenticated, remote attackers could write arbitrary files to the operating system and execute commands with root privileges. The post Cisco Warns of Exploited Secure Email Gateway Vulnerability appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: Cisco 警告 Secure Email Gateway 漏洞已遭利用
items.summary_zh: 未經身份驗證的遠端攻擊者可以在作業系統中寫入任意檔案，並以 root 權限執行命令。Cisco 警告 Secure Email Gateway 漏洞已遭利用的文章首次出現在 SecurityWeek 上。
